source_kind: Complete accessible PostgreSQL pg_catalog.pg_operator catalog literal and referenced pg_get_functiondef/prosrc for each typed operator; native compiled source and original CREATE OPERATOR command unavailable
findings: Typed integer division / is non-floating; spatial / divides by a point, interval and currency division have distinct return semantics. No unsupported generic-operator deduplication.

The < and <= overloads include typed numeric, text, network, time/date, range, JSONB and geometric ordering; geometry uses area/length where defined, and date/timestamptz casts can depend on session timezone. Preserve core ordering/operator-family behavior.
Of the 26 <-> overloads, spatial operands mean distance, whereas tsquery<->tsquery is phrase concatenation returning tsquery. No safe generic merge.
The << symbol means network subnet, bitshift, spatial left-of or range-before depending on types; <<= means inclusive subnet, <<| means vertical below. Not interchangeable.

All 200 referenced native implementation functions exist and present reciprocal commutator/negator links are intact. Direct relation dependencies alone cannot rule out index opfamilies, dynamic queries or clients; no deletion justified.

No reproducible application defect or measured app-specific performance bottleneck evidenced by this unchanged PostgreSQL core range. Compiled native implementations and original CREATE OPERATOR source are UNVERIFIED.
